most_similar_reason: Candidate 9 is essentially the same myth cycle as the target: an earth/sky-descended god-king murdered and dismembered by his jealous brother, his sister-wife (aided by another goddess) searching for and reassembling the pieces, magically reviving him to conceive a son who later avenges him and defeats the usurping brother, with the god thereafter ruling the underworld.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 1 concerns a solitary ancestor/creator figure who forms humans and animals from reeds and then forgets and abandons his creation, sharing none of the target's distinctive familial murder, dismemberment, resurrection, or maternal-protection motifs.
